name: ism868-sensors
description: Decode the sensor readings of the LaCrosse IT+ sensors (lacrosse_tx29, lacrosse_tx35, FSK) of the 868 MHz SRD band at once: the chain of ism868_pulses followed by sensor_decode, one JSON text packet per reading.

rf.description: RTL-SDR IQ at 2 MS/s centred at 868.5 MHz

readings.description: One packet per reading: the JSON text of the reading (model, id, values, mic, freq_MHz, rssi_dB, repeats), indexed like the pulse train it came from
